items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Me and Sonny come up together. ... Sonny Henry, he must know cause he was in the Eureka. Years ago.

ctx.x: We'll just check it to see if it's recording loud enough and you can just carry on the conversation. What were you saying about Perez? What did you say about Manuel Perez?
Oh, I said he was a wonderful trumpet player. Oh, yes, I said. Oh, he was fine. These people got a grocery bag down there on Bourbon Street, Tudor or somewhere. Sonny had this some street or another.
Oh, I'll ask some of the fellas in that neighborhood about it.
